name: Groupe CRIT SA
summary: Groupe CRIT SA engages in the temporary staffing business in Germany, Spain, Italy, Portugal, Morocco, Tunisia, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Africa, and the United States. The company offers human resource services, such as temporary work and recruitment, and training and consulting services; and engages in engineering and industrial maintenance activities under the ECM and Maser brands. It also provides airport assistance services, such as passenger and aircraft assistance, traffic, and freight assistance services to airlines, and airports and freight logistics providers/GSA forwarders. The company was incorporated in 1962 and is headquartered in Paris, France.
